zh.radiusLabel: `--dsw-radius-xs…panel` = 4 / 8 / 12 / 16 / 20 / 28 · 读数取 border-top-left-radius 的计算值（档位值取自 data/tokens.json）
zh.elevationTitle: 高程：三层阴影 + 一层弹层
zh.elevationLabel: 卡片用贴地 hairline，浮层才用阴影；读数读的是 box-shadow 的计算值（压缩显示）
zh.typeLabel: 用角色而不是裸字号：`--dsw-font-xxxs-11` … `--dsw-font-xl-24`，每个都是一整条 font 简写
zh.colourTitle: 语义色：同一行两块，浅深各解一次
zh.colourLabel: 左右两块用同一批 `--dsw-alias-*`，只有 color-scheme 不同；色值那一列是浏览器当场算出来的

en.radiusTitle: There are only six corner steps
en.radiusLabel: `--dsw-radius-xs…panel` = 4 / 8 / 12 / 16 / 20 / 28 · the readout is the computed border-top-left-radius (step values taken from data/tokens.json)
en.elevationTitle: Elevation: three shadow levels, plus one for what floats
en.elevationLabel: A surface in the flow gets the hairline; only what floats gets a shadow. The readout is the computed box-shadow, truncated
en.typeLabel: Reach for a role, not a bare font size: `--dsw-font-xxxs-11` … `--dsw-font-xl-24`, each one a whole font shorthand
en.colourTitle: Semantic colours: two panels side by side, light and dark each resolving the token once
en.colourLabel: Both panels use the same `--dsw-alias-*` set and differ only in color-scheme; the value column is what the browser works out on the spot
